# Evidence
- Problem class: go-json-polymorphic-health-response
- Model: openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash
- Solved: 2026-09-26T13:50:22.892Z
- Verification: solution produced by pi in sandbox; see signatures.json

signatures.description: In a Go CLI, an HTTP health endpoint returned a checks object whose values mixed subsystem objects such as database:{status:ok} with boolean readiness entries such as live:true and ready:true. Decoding checks as map[string]struct{Status string} failed with json: cannot unmarshal bool into Go struct field. The fix was to decode checks as map[string]json.RawMessage, then unmarshal only the database entry into a status struct; malformed or missing database entries remain failures. Verification: focused doctor tests passed and the Tier 1 guard reported secrets/build/lint/tests PASS before timing out.
